<![CDATA[import type { Metadata, Viewport } from "next";
import { Fraunces, Outfit, Space_Mono } from "next/font/google";
import "./mesamarket/mesamarket.css";

const display = Fraunces({
  subsets: ["latin"],
  variable: "--font-fraunces",
  display: "swap",
});

const body = Outfit({
  subsets: ["latin"],
  variable: "--font-outfit",
  display: "swap",
});

const mono = Space_Mono({
  subsets: ["latin"],
  weight: ["400", "700"],
  variable: "--font-space-mono",
  display: "swap",
});

export const metadata: Metadata = {
  metadataBase: new URL("https://openlandingpage.vercel.app"),
  title: "MESA MARKET — Good things come into season",
  description:
    "A farm-to-door grocery landing page with an interactive market shelf and live crate builder. All pricing and produce are illustrative demonstrations.",
  openGraph: {
    title: "MESA MARKET — Good things come into season",
    description: "Modern produce poster meets farm-to-door grocery.",

    card: "summary_large_image",

};

export const viewport: Viewport = {

export default function Layout({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {

      <body className="mesa-root bg-[#FDF5E7] text-[#24211D] antialiased">
        {children}
      </body>

}

    <file path="src/app/(mesamarket)/mesamarket/assets.tsx">
<![CDATA[import { ASSETS } from "./assets.generated";

const BASE = "/templates/mesamarket";

export function assetSrc(key: string, width: 800 | 1600, format: "webp" | "avif" = "webp"): string | null {
  return key in ASSETS ? `${BASE}/${key}-${width}.${format}` : null;
}

type PictureProps = { assetKey: string; alt: string; className?: string; sizes?: string; priority?: boolean };

export function Picture({ assetKey, alt, className, sizes = "(min-width: 900px) 50vw, 100vw", priority = false }: PictureProps) {
  const asset = ASSETS[assetKey];
  if (!asset) {
    return (
      <div className={`mm-placeholder ${className ?? ""}`} role="img" aria-label={alt} data-asset={assetKey}>
        <span className="mm-mono">{assetKey}</span>
      </div>
    );
  }
  const set = (f: "webp" | "avif") => `${assetSrc(assetKey, 800, f)} 800w, ${assetSrc(assetKey, 1600, f)} 1600w`;
  return (
    <picture className={className}>
      <source type="image/avif" srcSet={set("avif")} sizes={sizes} />
      <img
        src={`${BASE}/${assetKey}-800.webp`}
        srcSet={set("webp")}
        sizes={sizes}
        width={asset.w}
        height={asset.h}
        alt={alt}
        loading={priority ? "eager" : "lazy"}
        fetchPriority={priority ? "high" : undefined}
        decoding="async"
        data-asset={assetKey}
      />
    </picture>
  );
}

<![CDATA[@import "tailwindcss";

@theme {
  --color-mm-tomato: #D94C32;
  --color-mm-leaf: #3F7047;
  --color-mm-butter: #F2C94D;
  --color-mm-cream: #FDF5E7;
  --color-mm-blueberry: #494D78;
  --color-mm-ink: #24211D;
  --font-display: var(--font-fraunces), Georgia, serif;
  --font-body: var(--font-outfit), system-ui, sans-serif;
  --font-mono: var(--font-space-mono), ui-monospace, monospace;
}

:root {
  --mm-tomato: #D94C32;
  --mm-leaf: #3F7047;
  --mm-butter: #F2C94D;
  --mm-cream: #FDF5E7;
  --mm-blueberry: #494D78;
  --mm-ink: #24211D;
}

html {
  scroll-behavior: smooth;
  background-color: var(--mm-cream);
  color: var(--mm-ink);
}

.mesa-root {
  background-color: var(--mm-cream);
  color: var(--mm-ink);
  font-family: var(--font-outfit), -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif;
  min-height: 100vh;
}

.mesa-root .mm-display {
  font-family: var(--font-fraunces), Georgia, serif;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
}

.mesa-root .mm-mono {
  font-family: var(--font-space-mono), monospace;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}

.mesa-root .mm-produce-cutout {
  transition: transform 220ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
}

.mesa-root .mm-produce-cutout:hover,
.mesa-root .mm-produce-cutout:focus-within {
  transform: rotate(-3.5deg) scale(1.04);
}

.mesa-root .mm-cutout-disc {
  border-radius: 9999px;
  background-color: #f6ebd8;
  border: 2px solid var(--mm-ink);
  box-shadow: 3px 3px 0px var(--mm-ink);
  overflow: hidden;
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .mesa-root .mm-produce-cutout,
  .mesa-root .mm-produce-cutout:hover,
  .mesa-root .mm-produce-cutout:focus-within {
    transition: none !important;
    transform: none !important;
  }
}

<![CDATA['use client';

import React, { useReducer, useState, useRef } from 'react';
import {
  INITIAL_BASKET_STATE,
  basketReducer,
  calculateBasketTotals,
  ProduceCategory,
  ProduceId,
} from './basket/model';
import { Header } from './sections/Header';
import { HeroStall } from './sections/HeroStall';
import { ProduceShelf } from './sections/ProduceShelf';
import { MealKits } from './sections/MealKits';
import { ProducerRoute } from './sections/ProducerRoute';
import { ReceiptSection } from './sections/ReceiptSection';
import { Footer } from './sections/Footer';
import { BasketPill } from './sections/BasketPill';
import { BasketDrawer } from './sections/BasketDrawer';

export function MesaMarketApp() {
  const [basketState, dispatch] = useReducer(basketReducer, INITIAL_BASKET_STATE);
  const [activeCategory, setActiveCategory] = useState<ProduceCategory>('all');
  const [drawerOpen, setDrawerOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [justAddedId, setJustAddedId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const basketPillRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement | null>(null);

  const totals = calculateBasketTotals(basketState.quantities);

  const handleAddProduce = (productId: ProduceId) => {
    dispatch({ type: 'ADD', productId });
    setJustAddedId(productId);
    window.setTimeout(() => setJustAddedId(null), 350);
  };

  const handleAddKit = (kitId: string) => {
    dispatch({ type: 'ADD_KIT', kitId });
    setDrawerOpen(true);
  };

  return (
    <div id="top" className="mesa-root min-h-screen overflow-x-hidden selection:bg-[#D94C32] selection:text-[#FDF5E7]">
      <a
        href="#mm-shelf"
        className="sr-only focus:not-sr-only focus:fixed focus:top-4 focus:left-4 focus:z-50 focus:px-4 focus:py-2 focus:bg-[#D94C32] focus:text-[#FDF5E7] focus:font-bold focus:rounded-md"
      >
        Skip to market shelf
      </a>

      {/* Market Signage Header */}
      <Header
        totalCount={totals.totalCount}
        sampleSubtotal={totals.sampleSubtotal}
        onOpenBasket={() => setDrawerOpen(true)}
      />

      <main id="main">
        {/* 01: Flat-Lay Market Stall Collage Hero with Left Category Rail */}
        <HeroStall
          activeCategory={activeCategory}
          onSelectCategory={setActiveCategory}
          onAddProduce={handleAddProduce}
        />

        {/* 02: Live Category Filter & Interactive Produce Shelf */}
        <ProduceShelf
          activeCategory={activeCategory}
          onSelectCategory={setActiveCategory}
          quantities={basketState.quantities}
          onAdd={handleAddProduce}
          onDecrement={(id) => dispatch({ type: 'DECREMENT', productId: id })}
          justAddedId={justAddedId}
          lastAnnouncement={basketState.lastAnnouncement}
        />

        {/* 03: Seasonal Meal Kit Explorer */}
        <MealKits onAddKit={handleAddKit} />

        {/* 04: Producer Story Comic Strip & Illustrated SVG Delivery Loop */}
        <ProducerRoute />

        {/* 05: Sample Order Review / Receipt Card */}
        <ReceiptSection
          lines={totals.lines}
          totalCount={totals.totalCount}
          sampleSubtotal={totals.sampleSubtotal}
        />
      </main>

      {/* Grocery-Receipt Footer */}
      <Footer />

      {/* Floating Persistent Basket Pill */}
      <BasketPill
        buttonRef={basketPillRef}
        totalCount={totals.totalCount}
        sampleSubtotal={totals.sampleSubtotal}
        onOpen={() => setDrawerOpen(true)}
      />

      {/* Accessible Basket Drawer */}
      <BasketDrawer
        isOpen={drawerOpen}
        onClose={() => setDrawerOpen(false)}
        lines={totals.lines}
        totalCount={totals.totalCount}
        sampleSubtotal={totals.sampleSubtotal}
        onAdd={handleAddProduce}
        onDecrement={(id) => dispatch({ type: 'DECREMENT', productId: id })}
        onRemove={(id) => dispatch({ type: 'REMOVE', productId: id })}
        onClear={() => dispatch({ type: 'CLEAR' })}
        basketPillRef={basketPillRef}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
]]>

export const MEAL_KIT_PRESETS: MealKitPreset[] = [

    description:
      'One of every seasonal harvest item on the stall—vegetables, orchard fruit, and fresh-baked sourdough boule in a single crate.',
    items: PRODUCE_CATALOG.map((p) => ({ productId: p.id, qty: 1 })),
  },
];

export type BasketQuantities = Partial<Record<ProduceId, number>>;

export interface BasketState {
  quantities: BasketQuantities;
  lastAnnouncement: string;
}

export type BasketAction =
  | { type: 'ADD'; productId: ProduceId }
  | { type: 'DECREMENT'; productId: ProduceId }
  | { type: 'REMOVE'; productId: ProduceId }
  | { type: 'CLEAR' }
  | { type: 'ADD_KIT'; kitId: string };

export const INITIAL_BASKET_STATE: BasketState = {
  quantities: {
    tomato: 1,
    bread: 1,
  },
  lastAnnouncement: 'Sample basket initialized with 2 seasonal items.',
};

export function basketReducer(state: BasketState, action: BasketAction): BasketState {
  switch (action.type) {
    case 'ADD': {
      const product = PRODUCE_CATALOG.find((p) => p.id === action.productId);
      if (!product) return state;
      const current = state.quantities[action.productId] || 0;
      if (current >= product.maxQty) {
        return {
          ...state,
          lastAnnouncement: `Maximum sample limit (${product.maxQty}) reached for ${product.name}.`,
        };
      }
      const nextQty = current + 1;
      return {
        quantities: { ...state.quantities, [action.productId]: nextQty },
        lastAnnouncement: `Added ${product.name} to basket (qty ${nextQty}).`,
      };
    }
    case 'DECREMENT': {
      const product = PRODUCE_CATALOG.find((p) => p.id === action.productId);
      const current = state.quantities[action.productId] || 0;
      if (current <= 0) return state;
      const nextQuantities = { ...state.quantities };
      if (current === 1) {
        delete nextQuantities[action.productId];
        return {
          quantities: nextQuantities,
          lastAnnouncement: `Removed ${product?.name || action.productId} from basket.`,
        };
      }
      nextQuantities[action.productId] = current - 1;
      return {
        quantities: nextQuantities,
        lastAnnouncement: `Decreased ${product?.name || action.productId} quantity to ${current - 1}.`,
      };
    }
    case 'REMOVE': {
      const product = PRODUCE_CATALOG.find((p) => p.id === action.productId);
      const nextQuantities = { ...state.quantities };
      delete nextQuantities[action.productId];
      return {
        quantities: nextQuantities,
        lastAnnouncement: `Removed ${product?.name || action.productId} from sample basket.`,
      };
    }
    case 'CLEAR': {
      return {
        quantities: {},
        lastAnnouncement: 'Cleared all items from sample produce basket.',
      };
    }
    case 'ADD_KIT': {
      const kit = MEAL_KIT_PRESETS.find((k) => k.id === action.kitId);
      if (!kit) return state;
      const nextQuantities = { ...state.quantities };
      const addedNames: string[] = [];
      for (const entry of kit.items) {
        const prod = PRODUCE_CATALOG.find((p) => p.id === entry.productId);
        if (!prod) continue;
        const current = nextQuantities[entry.productId] || 0;
        const updated = Math.min(prod.maxQty, current + entry.qty);
        nextQuantities[entry.productId] = updated;
        addedNames.push(prod.name);
      }
      return {
        quantities: nextQuantities,
        lastAnnouncement: `Added ${kit.name} ingredients (${addedNames.join(', ')}) to basket.`,
      };
    }
    default:
      return state;
  }
}

export interface BasketLineItem {
  product: ProduceProduct;
  qty: number;
  lineSubtotal: number;
}

export function calculateBasketTotals(quantities: BasketQuantities): {
  lines: BasketLineItem[];
  totalCount: number;
  sampleSubtotal: number;
} {
  const lines: BasketLineItem[] = [];
  let totalCount = 0;
  let sampleSubtotal = 0;

  for (const product of PRODUCE_CATALOG) {
    const qty = quantities[product.id] || 0;
    if (qty > 0) {
      const lineSubtotal = Number((qty * product.samplePrice).toFixed(2));
      lines.push({ product, qty, lineSubtotal });
      totalCount += qty;
      sampleSubtotal = Number((sampleSubtotal + lineSubtotal).toFixed(2));
    }
  }

  return {
    lines,
    totalCount,
    sampleSubtotal,
  };
}
]]>
    </file>

<![CDATA['use client';

import React, { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { BasketLineItem, ProduceId } from '../basket/model';
import { SafeImage } from './SafeImage';

interface BasketDrawerProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  lines: BasketLineItem[];
  totalCount: number;
  sampleSubtotal: number;
  onAdd: (id: ProduceId) => void;
  onDecrement: (id: ProduceId) => void;
  onRemove: (id: ProduceId) => void;
  onClear: () => void;
  basketPillRef: React.RefObject<HTMLButtonElement | null>;
}

export const BasketDrawer: React.FC<BasketDrawerProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  lines,
  totalCount,
  sampleSubtotal,
  onAdd,
  onDecrement,
  onRemove,
  onClear,
  basketPillRef,
}) => {
  const drawerCloseRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) return;
    const t = window.setTimeout(() => drawerCloseRef.current?.focus(), 30);
    const onKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        onClose();
        basketPillRef.current?.focus();
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);
    return () => {
      window.clearTimeout(t);
      window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);
    };
  }, [isOpen, onClose, basketPillRef]);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  return (
    <div
      role="dialog"
      aria-modal="true"
      aria-labelledby="mm-drawer-title"
      className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex justify-end bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xs"
      onClick={(e) => {
        if (e.target === e.currentTarget) {
          onClose();
          basketPillRef.current?.focus();
        }
      }}
    >
      <div className="bg-[#FDF5E7] text-[#24211D] border-l-2 border-[#24211D] w-full max-w-md h-full p-6 flex flex-col justify-between overflow-y-auto shadow-2xl">
        <div className="space-y-5">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b-2 border-[#24211D] pb-4">
            <div>
              <div className="mm-mono text-[11px] font-bold text-[#D94C32] tracking-wider uppercase">
                ILLUSTRATIVE MARKET BASKET
              </div>
              <h3 id="mm-drawer-title" className="mm-display font-extrabold text-2xl">
                Your Harvest Crate ({totalCount})
              </h3>
            </div>
            <button
              ref={drawerCloseRef}
              type="button"
              onClick={() => {
                onClose();
                basketPillRef.current?.focus();
              }}
              className="px-3 py-1 bg-[#24211D] text-[#FDF5E7] mm-mono text-xs rounded cursor-pointer hover:bg-[#3F7047] transition-colors"
            >
              Esc / Close
            </button>
          </div>

          {lines.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="py-12 text-center space-y-2 border-2 border-dashed border-[#24211D]/30 rounded-xl p-6">
              <div className="mm-display font-bold text-xl">Your crate is empty</div>
              <p className="text-xs text-[#24211D]/75">
                Add seasonal vegetables, fruit, or hearth bread from the shelf to preview your sample box.
              </p>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <ul className="space-y-3">
              {lines.map((line) => (
                <li
                  key={line.product.id}
                  className="bg-white border-2 border-[#24211D] rounded-lg p-3 flex items-center justify-between gap-3 shadow-[2px_2px_0px_#24211D]"
                >
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                    <div className="w-12 h-12 shrink-0 flex items-center justify-center">
                      <SafeImage
                        src={line.product.image}
                        alt={line.product.name}
                        fallbackTint="transparent"
                        className="w-full h-full object-contain"
                      />
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <div className="font-bold text-sm">{line.product.name}</div>
                      <div className="mm-mono text-[11px] text-[#24211D]/70">
                        ${line.product.samplePrice.toFixed(2)} each · Subtotal $
                        {line.lineSubtotal.toFixed(2)}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => onDecrement(line.product.id)}
                      aria-label={`Decrease ${line.product.name}`}
                      className="w-7 h-7 border border-[#24211D] rounded mm-mono text-xs font-bold hover:bg-[#F2C94D] transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                    >
                      −
                    </button>
                    <span className="mm-mono text-xs font-bold w-5 text-center">
                      {line.qty}
                    </span>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      disabled={line.qty >= line.product.maxQty}
                      onClick={() => onAdd(line.product.id)}
                      aria-label={`Increase ${line.product.name}`}
                      className="w-7 h-7 border border-[#24211D] rounded mm-mono text-xs font-bold hover:bg-[#F2C94D] disabled:opacity-40 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                    >
                      +
                    </button>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => onRemove(line.product.id)}
                      aria-label={`Remove ${line.product.name} from basket`}
                      className="ml-1 px-1.5 py-1 text-[10px] mm-mono bg-[#D94C32]/15 text-[#D94C32] rounded hover:bg-[#D94C32] hover:text-white transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                    >
                      ×
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          )}
        </div>

        <div className="border-t-2 border-[#24211D] pt-4 space-y-3 mt-6">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between mm-mono text-base font-bold">
            <span>SAMPLE SUBTOTAL</span>
            <span className="text-xl text-[#D94C32]">${sampleSubtotal.toFixed(2)}</span>
          </div>
          <p className="mm-mono text-[11px] text-[#24211D]/75">
            Sample basket only — no checkout, delivery scheduling, or payment is performed.
          </p>
          <div className="flex gap-2">
            {lines.length > 0 && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={onClear}
                className="px-4 py-2.5 border-2 border-[#24211D] rounded-lg mm-mono text-xs font-bold uppercase hover:bg-[#D94C32]/15 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
              >
                Clear Crate
              </button>
            )}
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => {
                onClose();
                document.getElementById('mm-checkout')?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
              }}
              className="flex-1 py-2.5 bg-[#3F7047] text-[#FDF5E7] border-2 border-[#24211D] rounded-lg mm-mono text-xs font-bold uppercase hover:bg-[#315938] transition-colors cursor-pointer"
            >
              View Sample Receipt
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};
]]>
    </file>

              </div>
              <h3 className="mm-display font-bold text-2xl text-[#24211D]">{kit.name}</h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-[#24211D]/80 leading-relaxed">{kit.description}</p>
              <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5 pt-2">
                {kit.items.map((entry) => {
                  const prod = PRODUCE_CATALOG.find((p) => p.id === entry.productId);
                  return (
                    <span
                      key={entry.productId}
                      className="px-2 py-0.5 bg-[#FDF5E7] border border-[#24211D] rounded mm-mono text-[11px] font-bold"
                    >
                      {entry.qty}× {prod?.name.split(' ')[0]}
                    </span>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            </div>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => onAddKit(kit.id)}
              className="w-full py-3 bg-[#3F7047] text-[#FDF5E7] border-2 border-[#24211D] rounded-lg mm-mono text-xs font-bold uppercase hover:bg-[#315938] transition-colors cursor-pointer shadow-[2px_2px_0px_#24211D]"
            >
              Add ingredients ({kit.items.length} items)
            </button>
          </article>
        ))}
      </div>
    </section>
  );
};
]]>
    </file>

    >

    <file path="src/app/(mesamarket)/mesamarket/sections/ProduceShelf.tsx">
<![CDATA['use client';

import React from 'react';
import {
  PRODUCE_CATALOG,
  ProduceCategory,
  ProduceId,
  BasketQuantities,
} from '../basket/model';
import { SafeImage } from './SafeImage';

interface ProduceShelfProps {
  activeCategory: ProduceCategory;
  onSelectCategory: (cat: ProduceCategory) => void;
  quantities: BasketQuantities;
  onAdd: (id: ProduceId) => void;
  onDecrement: (id: ProduceId) => void;
  justAddedId: string | null;
  lastAnnouncement: string;
}

export const ProduceShelf: React.FC<ProduceShelfProps> = ({
  activeCategory,
  onSelectCategory,
  quantities,
  onAdd,
  onDecrement,
  justAddedId,
  lastAnnouncement,
}) => {
  const filteredProducts = PRODUCE_CATALOG.filter((p) =>
    activeCategory === 'all' ? true : p.category === activeCategory
  );

  return (
    <section
      id="mm-shelf"
      aria-labelledby="mm-shelf-heading"
      className="max-w-[1440px] mx-auto px-4 sm:px-8 py-16 sm:py-20 border-b-2 border-[#24211D]"
    >
      <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-end justify-between gap-6 mb-8">
        <div>
          <div className="mm-mono text-xs font-bold uppercase text-[#3F7047] tracking-wider">
            01 · INTERACTIVE PRODUCE SHELF (SAMPLE PRICING)
          </div>
          <h2 id="mm-shelf-heading" className="mm-display font-extrabold text-3xl sm:text-5xl mt-1">
            Hand-arranged harvest shelf
          </h2>
        </div>

        {/* Accessible Category Filter Tabs */}
        <div
          role="tablist"
          aria-label="Produce category filter"
          className="inline-flex flex-wrap gap-1.5 p-1.5 bg-[#F2C94D]/45 border-2 border-[#24211D] rounded-xl"
        >
          {(
            [
              { id: 'all', label: 'All' },
              { id: 'vegetables', label: 'Vegetables' },
              { id: 'fruit', label: 'Fruit' },
              { id: 'pantry', label: 'Pantry' },
            ] as { id: ProduceCategory; label: string }[]
          ).map((tab) => {
            const active = activeCategory === tab.id;
            return (
              <button
                key={tab.id}
                type="button"
                role="tab"
                aria-selected={active}
                onClick={() => onSelectCategory(tab.id)}
                className={`px-4 py-2 mm-mono text-xs font-bold rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap shrink-0 ${
                  active
                    ? 'bg-[#24211D] text-[#FDF5E7]'
                    : 'text-[#24211D] hover:bg-[#FDF5E7]'
                }`}
              >
                {tab.label}
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Live Status Announcement */}
      <div aria-live="polite" className="sr-only">
        {lastAnnouncement}
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6">
        {filteredProducts.map((product) => {
          const inBasketQty = quantities[product.id] || 0;
          const isMax = inBasketQty >= product.maxQty;
          const pulsed = justAddedId === product.id;

          return (
            <article
              key={product.id}
              className={`bg-[#FDF5E7] border-2 border-[#24211D] rounded-xl p-5 flex flex-col justify-between space-y-4 transition-transform shadow-[3px_3px_0px_#24211D] ${
                pulsed ? 'scale-[1.02] ring-2 ring-[#D94C32]' : ''
              }`}
            >
              <div className="space-y-3">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                  <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 bg-[#F2C94D] border border-[#24211D] rounded-full mm-mono text-xs font-bold">
                    ${product.samplePrice.toFixed(2)} · {product.unit}
                  </span>
                  {inBasketQty > 0 && (
                    <span className="px-2 py-0.5 bg-[#3F7047] text-[#FDF5E7] rounded-full mm-mono text-[11px] font-bold">
                      In Basket: {inBasketQty}
                    </span>
                  )}
                </div>

                <div className="h-40 flex items-center justify-center p-2">
                  <div className="w-32 h-32 mm-cutout-disc flex items-center justify-center p-1.5 mm-produce-cutout">
                    <SafeImage
                      src={product.image}
                      alt={product.name}
                      fallbackTint="transparent"
                      className="w-full h-full object-cover rounded-full"
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <div className="mm-mono text-[11px] text-[#494D78] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider">
                    {product.originDescriptor}
                  </div>
                  <h3 className="mm-display font-bold text-xl text-[#24211D]">
                    {product.name}
                  </h3>
                  <p className="text-xs text-[#24211D]/80 leading-relaxed">
                    {product.seasonalNote}
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="pt-3 border-t border-[#24211D]/15 flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                {inBasketQty > 0 ? (
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 w-full justify-between">
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => onDecrement(product.id)}
                      aria-label={`Decrease quantity of ${product.name}`}
                      className="px-3 py-2 bg-[#FDF5E7] border-2 border-[#24211D] rounded-lg mm-mono text-xs font-bold hover:bg-[#F2C94D] transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                    >
                      −
                    </button>
                    <span className="mm-mono text-xs font-bold">
                      {inBasketQty} in crate
                    </span>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      disabled={isMax}
                      onClick={() => onAdd(product.id)}
                      aria-label={`Increase quantity of ${product.name}`}
                      className="px-3 py-2 bg-[#D94C32] text-[#FDF5E7] border-2 border-[#24211D] rounded-lg mm-mono text-xs font-bold disabled:opacity-40 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                    >
                      +
                    </button>
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => onAdd(product.id)}
                    className="w-full py-2.5 bg-[#D94C32] text-[#FDF5E7] border-2 border-[#24211D] rounded-lg mm-mono text-xs font-bold uppercase hover:bg-[#b83b24] transition-colors cursor-pointer shadow-[2px_2px_0px_#24211D]"
                  >
                    Add to Basket · ${product.samplePrice.toFixed(2)}
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>
            </article>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </section>
  );
};
]]>
    </file>
    <file path="src/app/(mesamarket)/mesamarket/sections/ReceiptSection.tsx">
<![CDATA['use client';

import React from 'react';
import { BasketLineItem, MESA_MARKET_ASSETS } from '../basket/model';
import { SafeImage } from './SafeImage';

interface ReceiptSectionProps {
  lines: BasketLineItem[];
  totalCount: number;
  sampleSubtotal: number;
}

export const ReceiptSection: React.FC<ReceiptSectionProps> = ({
  lines,
  totalCount,
  sampleSubtotal,
}) => {
  return (
    <section
      id="mm-checkout"
      aria-labelledby="mm-checkout-heading"
      className="max-w-[1440px] mx-auto px-4 sm:px-8 py-16 sm:py-20"
    >
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-10 items-start">
        <div className="lg:col-span-6 space-y-4">
          <div className="mm-mono text-xs font-bold uppercase text-[#D94C32] tracking-wider">
            04 · SAMPLE ORDER RECEIPT (NO PAYMENT PROCESSING)
          </div>
          <h2 id="mm-checkout-heading" className="mm-display font-extrabold text-3xl sm:text-5xl">
            Review your sample harvest crate
          </h2>
          <p className="text-sm text-[#24211D]/80 leading-relaxed">
            This grocery receipt reflects your live basket selections above. All prices, origins, and stock counts are illustrative demonstrations.
          </p>
          <div className="aspect-[16/9] rounded-xl overflow-hidden border-2 border-[#24211D] shadow-[4px_4px_0px_#24211D]">
            <SafeImage
              src={MESA_MARKET_ASSETS.marketTable}
              alt="Mesa Market wooden harvest table overflowing with seasonal produce"
              loading="lazy"
              className="w-full h-full object-cover"
            />
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Printed Grocery Receipt Card */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-6 bg-white border-2 border-[#24211D] rounded-xl p-6 sm:p-8 shadow-[6px_6px_0px_#24211D] space-y-5">
          <div className="border-b-2 border-dashed border-[#24211D] pb-4 flex items-center justify-between">
            <div>
              <div className="mm-mono text-sm font-bold">MESA MARKET · CRATE RECEIPT</div>
              <div className="mm-mono text-[11px] text-[#24211D]/70">
                SAMPLE ORDER REVIEW ONLY — NO CHECKOUT OR CHARGE
              </div>
            </div>
            <span className="px-2.5 py-1 bg-[#F2C94D] border border-[#24211D] mm-mono text-xs font-bold rounded">
              {totalCount} ITEMS
            </span>
          </div>

          {lines.length === 0 ? (
            <p className="mm-mono text-xs text-center py-8 text-[#24211D]/70">
              Your sample basket is empty. Add items from the shelf or meal kits above!
            </p>
          ) : (
            <ul className="divide-y divide-dashed divide-[#24211D]/25 mm-mono text-xs">
              {lines.map((line) => (
                <li key={line.product.id} className="py-2.5 flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
                  <div>
                    <span className="font-bold">
                      {line.qty}× {line.product.name}
                    </span>
                    <span className="block text-[11px] text-[#24211D]/65">
                      {line.product.unit} @ ${line.product.samplePrice.toFixed(2)}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <span className="font-bold">${line.lineSubtotal.toFixed(2)}</span>
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          )}

          <div className="border-t-2 border-[#24211D] pt-4 space-y-2 mm-mono text-sm">
            <div className="flex justify-between font-bold text-lg">
              <span>ILLUSTRATIVE SUBTOTAL</span>
              <span className="text-[#D94C32]">${sampleSubtotal.toFixed(2)}</span>
            </div>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-[#24211D]/70">
              Demonstration receipt only. No payment details are collected or processed.
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
};
]]>
    </file>
    <file path="src/app/(mesamarket)/mesamarket/sections/SafeImage.tsx">
<![CDATA['use client';

import React, { useState } from 'react';

export interface SafeImageProps extends React.ImgHTMLAttributes<HTMLImageElement> {
  src: string;
  alt: string;
  fallbackLabel?: string;
  fallbackTint?: string;
}

export const SafeImage: React.FC<SafeImageProps> = ({
  src,
  alt,
  fallbackLabel,
  fallbackTint = '#f6ebd8',
  className = '',
  style,
  ...rest
}) => {
  const [failed, setFailed] = useState(false);

  if (failed || !src) {
    return (
      <div
        role={alt ? 'img' : 'presentation'}
        aria-label={alt || undefined}
        className={`relative flex flex-col items-center justify-center overflow-hidden p-3 text-center select-none ${className}`}
        style={{
          backgroundColor: fallbackTint,
          color: '#24211D',
          ...style,
        }}
      >
        <svg
          viewBox="0 0 120 80"
          className="w-10 h-8 opacity-40 mb-1 stroke-current"
          fill="none"
          strokeWidth="1.5"
          aria-hidden="true"
        >
          <rect x="6" y="6" width="108" height="68" rx="4" />
          <path d="M6 56 L38 32 L66 50 L88 26 L114 56" />
          <circle cx="84" cy="22" r="7" />
        </svg>
        {(fallbackLabel || alt) && (
          <span className="text-[10px] mm-mono font-bold tracking-wider opacity-75 max-w-[20ch] truncate">
            {fallbackLabel || alt}
          </span>
        )}
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <img
      src={src}
      alt={alt}
      referrerPolicy="no-referrer"
      onError={() => setFailed(true)}
      className={className}
      style={style}
      {...rest}
    />
  );
};
]]>
    </file>
